entries.2a9f53ab571de435: This division undertakes vibration testing and analysis on commission in response to requests from customers. It conducts environmental testing, including vibration testing of test items, and performs analysis based on the results. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,687 million.
entries.46c5cba937f390ef: This division manufactures and sells vibration measuring devices, vibration monitoring devices, seismic monitoring devices and environmental reliability evaluation systems, and provides their repair and maintenance. It is used in preventing secondary disasters caused by earthquakes and in predictive maintenance through detection of abnormal vibration in industrial machinery. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,232 million.
entries.47043e51ea074adc: Companies in automotive-related, defense, electric vehicle-related, aerospace and other fields
entries.8bd7bc1636fb1b80: This division manufactures and sells vibration simulation systems (vibration test equipment) and all-weather simulation systems (composite environment test equipment), and provides their repair and maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥13,021 million.
entries.932cf21da51efc4d: Operators of public infrastructure and private facilities
entries.93796468883d6114: Companies that outsource vibration testing and environmental testing
entries.d4bdc62590a51874: Manufacturing companies in automotive, aerospace, defense, electronics and other fields
entries.ed5c90c5a50e43ac: This business manufactures and sells vibration simulation systems and measuring systems, and undertakes vibration testing on commission. Because all of the business relates to vibration, it is disclosed as a single segment. The company conducts business together with seven consolidated subsidiaries (two in Japan and five overseas in Thailand, Vietnam, the United Kingdom and the United States).
entries.f1955a1ca250aaa2: A company that manufactures and sells vibration testing equipment and vibration measuring equipment, and undertakes vibration testing on a contract basis.
